topic: Single-runtime codebase audit and legacy retirement
currentUserGoal: Remove the old game rather than preserve it, eliminate unused code and assets, and leave the Ancient Grass ecosystem codebase smaller, verifiable, live, and synchronized.
workCompleted: Removed the original GameScene and TitleScene runtime together with their isolated data catalogs, systems, types, UI helpers, tests, harnesses, and media.
Removed the abandoned intermediate RedesignPrototypeScene generation, its isolated redesign modules, and its tests.
Made Ancient Grass: Ecosystem the only runtime; current playtest parameters open the field and retired aliases fall through to the ecosystem title.

Removed unused current exports, a redundant route flag, unreachable audio events, a second unused mobile touch synthesizer, obsolete documentation, duplicate research, mockups, duplicate icons, and runtime-unreferenced public assets.
Added Knip as npm run audit:code and made npm run check include lint, dead-code analysis, tests, TypeScript, and the production build.
Rewrote the project and performance manuals around the single ecosystem runtime and recorded durable audit metrics in docs/CODEBASE_AUDIT_2026-07-25.md.
Reduced source from 75 files and 45,807 lines to 27 files and 12,915 lines.
Reduced the application chunk from 998.33 kB (259.54 kB gzip) to 280.15 kB (76.46 kB gzip).
Reduced public assets from 162 files and 24.89 MiB to 68 files and 11.87 MiB.
filesChanged: retired source, tests, docs, mockups, and public assets listed by commit 6c06e9d
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, Knip, 154 Vitest tests across 18 files, strict TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
Madge found no circular dependencies from src/main.ts.
git diff --check passed and the public asset reference scan found no unreferenced runtime media.

nextRecommendedSteps: Continue gameplay work only on the ecosystem runtime and its current browser snapshots.
